name: Wicked Bobcat 71
author: hannahyockel
description: Rounded emerald button that scales up on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #1DC9A0 to #1dc9a0, border-color becomes #1DC9A0, text color changes from #FFFFFF to #1DC9A0.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Wicked Bobcat 71</title>
<style>
/* Wicked Bobcat 71 by hannahyockel — https://uiverse.io/hannahyockel/wicked-bobcat-71 */
button {
 display: flex;
 flex-direction: row;
 justify-content: center;
 align-items: center;
 padding: 15px 38px;
 border-radius: 16px;
 border: 1px solid transparent;
 color: #FFFFFF;
 background-color: #1DC9A0;
 font-size: 16px;
 letter-spacing: 1px;
 transition: all 0.15s linear;
}

button:hover {
 background-color: rgba(29, 201, 160, 0.08);
 border-color: #1DC9A0;
 color: #1DC9A0;
 transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.05);
}

button:active {
 background-color: transparent;
 border-color: #1DC9A0;
 color: #1DC9A0;
 transform: translateY(5px) scale(0.95);
}

button:disabled {
 background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
 color: #8E8E93;
 border-color: #8E8E93;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button> Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
